description_en: Queries the distribution of outbound traffic that contains personal information
description_zh: 查询个人信息出境流量分布
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-sensitive-outbound-distribution --instance-id waf-cn-tl32ast0000 --start-time 1672502400 --end-time 1725966000 --cluster-id 443 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSensitiveOutboundDistribution

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. The time is in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

> Compliance review supports queries for the last month, the last 3 months, the last 6 months, the last 12 months, and the period from January 1 of the previous year to the present. Make sure that the specified time range is valid
parameters.help_zh:
查询的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
> 合规审查当前仅支持查询最近1个月、最近3个月、最近6个月、最近12个月、自去年1月1日至今的数据，请确保时间的合法性
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. The time is in UTC.

> Compliance review supports queries for the last month, the last 3 months, the last 6 months, the last 12 months, and the period from January 1 of the previous year to the present. Make sure that the specified time range is valid
parameters.help_zh:
查询的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。

>合规审查当前仅支持查询最近1个月、最近3个月、最近6个月、最近12个月、自去年1月1日至今的数据，请确保时间的合法性
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.

> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html operation to obtain information about hybrid cloud clusters
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html获取混合云集群信息
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: regions outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
